title: Branch & Sandbox

body.text: Codex doesn't edit the main branch directly — every task works on a
new branch in a sandbox separate from your real code
, just like a good developer always cuts a feature branch first.

example: "Task 'add dark mode' → Codex creates a branch 'add-dark-mode', finishes the work, then proposes a diff to review"

title: How safe is the sandbox?

body.text: In the sandbox, code can run and tests can run, but it has
no access to production systems or real secrets
— even if the AI makes a mistake, the damage is limited to the sandbox.

example: "The AI ran tests and they broke in the sandbox? No problem — the real code on main is unaffected"

question: Which branch does Codex edit code on?

options.text: A new branch created separately for that task

question: If the AI's code breaks tests in the sandbox, what happens?

options.text: The real code is unaffected — damage stays in the sandbox

question: What can the sandbox NOT access?
Why is the Codex sandbox safe?

options.text: It runs separately from the real system — you can experiment without affecting production

question: How should you use Branch and Sandbox well?

options.text: Experiment with changes before merging into the main code
